text:
maria (Docs): Quick heads-up: infra changed v2 canonical idempotency header from Idempotency-Key -> Request-Id. Need tiny migration blurb + snippets.

samir (SDK): Ack. Plan to accept both names in SDK, prefer requestId param, map idempotencyKey -> requestId and emit a deprecation warning. I'll open a PR.

clem (Frontend): Our example client sets idempotencyKey by default. I'll switch examples to requestId and keep a one-release shim with console.warn.

maria (Docs): Snippet request: please paste minimal old/new examples for Node & Python and an HTTP example with the exact Warning header string so support can grep logs.

samir (SDK): Node: `// old: client.generate(..., idempotencyKey: uid) // new: client.generate(..., requestId: uid)` 
Python: `# old: client.generate(..., idempotency_key=uid) # new: client.generate(..., request_id=uid)`

maria (Docs): Thanks. HTTP example: `POST /v2/generate` with header `Request-Id: 123e4567-...` and body `{ "model": "redwood-7b", "input": "..." }`. Server will return `Warning: 299 "Idempotency-Key deprecated; use Request-Id"` if legacy header used.

jen (QA): I'll add two smoke tests to docs CI: (1) send same Request-Id twice -> deduped; (2) send Idempotency-Key -> accepted + Warning header present. Need PR numbers to wire tests.

lina (Support): I'll prepare KB draft describing how to detect the warning in logs and advise customers to update middleware.

infra-bot: Canary updated: v2 emits Warning header when Idempotency-Key is present; metric idempotency_warning_rate shipping to #eng-sre.

maria (Docs): Action items: samir PR (SDK), clem (examples), jen (smoke tests), lina (KB), me (migration blurb + verify checklist). Target: merge docs + SDK 48h before public deprecation email. Ping if blockers. :thumbsup:
